metadata.title: झारखंड का हिरणपुर बाज़ार | Biggest Herbal Medicine Market | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In this episode of Main Bhi Bharat, we take you to a unique haat (local market) in the Paduk district of Jharkhand, where tradition meets health. One of the most fascinating sections of this market is dedicated to medicines made from jadi butis (forest herbs) — a precious gift of nature passed down through generations by tribal healers.
These herbal medicines, sourced directly from the forests of Jharkhand, are known to cure various illnesses and ailments. The remedies are trusted by local communities, who rely on these natural solutions for their well-being. Every week, a large number of people from nearby villages visit this haat to buy these herbal medicines
